kitStops: Taormina: Taormina is a mountain town on the east coast of Sicily, just above Giardini Naxos. | Stand in awe before the ancient Greek theatre at the Teatro Antico | Stroll through the Piazza IX Aprile | Visit the Palazzo Corvaja

Matera: Matera is the capital of the Matera province in Basilicata, famous for its sassi rock cut settlements. | Visit the Matera Cathedral | See the Church of San Pietro Barisano | Walk through the Park of the Rupestrian Churches of Matera
Amalfi Coast: The Amalfi Coast in Campania is recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its iconic medieval cliffside fishing villages. | Take in the cliffside views along the Sentiero Degli Dei

Palermo: Palermo sits on the northern coast of Sicily, a city with a thousand years of history and beautiful Arab Norman architecture. | Visit the Palermo Cathedral | Step inside the Palatine Chapel | See the Palazzo dei Normanni
Monreale: Monreale lies near Palermo and is known for its cathedral. | Admire the Monreale Cathedral

Agrigento’s Valley of the Temples: Just outside Agrigento, the Valley of the Temples is one of the most important archaeological sites in Sicily, with remarkably well preserved Doric temples. | Marvel at the Temple of Concordia | See the Temple of Juno | Visit the Regional Archaeological Museum “Pietro Griffo”

Giardini Naxos: Giardini Naxos is a town on the east coast of Sicily, midway along the shore and just below Taormina. | Explore the Museo e Area Archeologica di Naxos | Relax at the Dal Pirata Beach | Visit the Parco fluviale dell'Alcantara

Strait of Messina: The Strait of Messina is reached through the port in the northeast corner of Sicily. | See the Duomo di Messina | Admire the Fontana di Orione | Visit the Museo regionale di Messina
Sorrento: Sorrento overlooks the Bay of Naples and is widely known for its ceramics, lacework, and woodwork shops.

Positano: Positano is a small picturesque town perched on the face of a hill, called the pearl of the Amalfi Coast. | Visit the Collegiata di Santa Maria Assunta | See the Roman archaeological museum and villa

Pompeii: Pompeii is a ruined ancient Roman city considered one of the few sites where an ancient city has been preserved in detail. | Walk through the Forum | See the House of the Faun | Visit the Temple of Apollo
